nodes.plm_action: Applying glue to legs of pants
nodes.plm_caption:
The video begins with a black screen and the words "DIY Thursday" in white and pink lettering, with "In/ Nike" below it. The video is a time lapsed tutorial on how to bleached jeans for your closet. A woman appears on screen with a group of tan jeans and a zip lock bag laid out in front of her.  She is applying light blue fabric glue to the seam of the jeans on top of the zip lock bag, which is laid out on the wooden floor. Next, she lays the jeans flat in a sink as a liquid dye is poured into the sink. She reaches in with a spoon and grabs the jeans and proceeds to submerge them in the dye. Once they are covered in the dye, she takes a purple washcloth and squeezes the dye out.  She lays the jeans back out onto the bag on top of the wooden floor, as she lays two of them out side by side. Then, as words say, "check out last weeks project!"
The end screen is black with white text saying "support by subscribing", and then, "check out last week's project! Threaded Hoop Earrings".

summary.brief: A woman shows how to create a watermark on denim using blue gel glue, then dyes, rinses, washes and air‑dries the jeans.
summary.detailed: The tutorial opens with a black intro screen that reads “DIY Thursday.” A woman spreads a pair of light‑colored jeans over a zip‑lock bag on a wooden floor and squeezes light‑blue gel Elmer’s glue onto the seams, drawing the desired watermark pattern. After the glue dries completely, she mixes fabric dye with cool water in a sink, then uses a spoon to lower the glued jeans into the dye, gently agitating them for several minutes to achieve an even color. She lifts the jeans, presses out excess dye with a purple washcloth, and rinses them under cool running water until the water runs clear. The jeans are placed in a washing machine on the shortest cycle, then removed and laid out on the bag to air‑dry. The video ends with a black screen showing a subscription prompt and a note to check out last week’s “Threaded Hoop Earrings” project.

action.detailed: Apply light‑blue gel glue to the jeans to form a watermark, let the glue dry, submerge the jeans in a dye bath, agitate briefly, squeeze out excess dye with a purple washcloth, rinse under running water, run a short wash cycle, and air‑dry the finished pieces.

nodes.plm_action: Soak garment in dye mixtur
nodes.plm_caption:
This video features a close-up shot of the leg of a white pair of pants on the ground covered by a plastic sheet. We also see a pair of legs that are submerged in a pan of red dye, with the legs being stirred with a spatula and washed with water. At the end we see a pair of legs submerged in a pan of purple dye, with the legs being squeezed and washed with water. There are also two pairs of painted pink and purple pants which are then displayed on a blue fabric on a wooden deck. There is a cut to a hand pouring silver paint over a hoop earring.
The video is an in-motion edit with a great amount of music and music transitions. At the end of the video we see the following text "check out last week's project! threaded hoop earrings." on a black screen. The entire video is in color and was shot on a black background.

summary.brief: The presenter dyes denim red, rinses it, washes a purple‑dyed piece, displays the finished pink and purple jeans, and finishes a hoop earring with glue.
summary.detailed: The segment begins with a pair of white jeans laid on a plastic sheet. Red fabric dye is poured into a stainless‑steel sink, the jeans are submerged, and a spoon is used to stir the dye into the fabric. After the dye has set, the denim is rinsed under running water. Next, a piece of purple‑dyed fabric is placed in the same sink, where the presenter crumples, twists, squeezes and rinses it repeatedly to remove excess dye. The camera then shows the completed pink‑dyed and purple‑dyed jeans arranged side‑by‑side on a blue cloth, each leg bearing white cursive lettering. Finally, close‑up shots show a hand with orange nail polish applying silver glue to a hoop earring and pushing colored thread into the hoop, ending with a screen promoting the previous week’s project.

action.detailed: Submerge the jeans in red dye, stir with a spoon until the color penetrates, rinse the dyed jeans under running water, then wash the purple‑dyed fabric by crumpling, twisting and squeezing it in the sink before arranging the finished pink and purple jeans on a blue cloth and applying glue to a hoop earring.
